proseChanges.summary: Records the v0.4.47 relay delivery diagnostics and upgrade steps from v0.4.46.
proseChanges.was: Owner-only relay send attempts left no delivery record.
proseChanges.now: Owner-only relay sends record each attempt’s HTTP status and any relay error code in the installation’s delivery table.
proseChanges.ownerAction: Update from v0.4.46 without resetting. Back up D1, R2, Durable Object state, private settings and installation encryption custody. Stop the old Worker before updating and retain native owners, memberships, permissions, support history, files, erasure fences and all applied migration identities. Use Node 22.20.0, pnpm 10.12.4 and rer 0.2.136. An installation on v0.4.46 needs no new migrations. For older installations, follow the upgrade steps in the intervening published releases and apply each missing migration once in filename order before serving HTTP or queue traffic. Run `rer deploy --dry-run` against the retained installation before deploying. On the first hosted deploy, supply `--owner-name` if the installation has no saved owner name. Retain the durable recovery revocation watermark on rollback. Portable restore requires fresh Managed recovery and custody binding.

publicReleaseNotes:
- **Owner sign-in relay delivery records.** Each owner sign-in email attempt through the Run Edit Run relay creates an `email_deliveries` row. The outcome records the relay’s HTTP status and any machine-readable error code, such as `business_mail_recipient_forbidden`. The row excludes recipients, message content and credentials.

Update from v0.4.46 without resetting. Back up D1, R2, Durable Object state, private settings and installation encryption custody. Stop the old Worker before updating and retain native owners, memberships, permissions, support history, files, erasure fences and all applied migration identities. Use Node 22.20.0, pnpm 10.12.4 and rer 0.2.136. An installation on v0.4.46 needs no new migrations. For older installations, follow the upgrade steps in the intervening published releases and apply each missing migration once in filename order before serving HTTP or queue traffic. Run `rer deploy --dry-run` against the retained installation before deploying. On the first hosted deploy, supply `--owner-name` if the installation has no saved owner name. Retain the durable recovery revocation watermark on rollback. Portable restore requires fresh Managed recovery and custody binding.
